subject: Flexible SLA package + seat discount proposal for Acme
messages:
From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA and pricing for pilot + seat discounts

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're lining up a 3-month pilot to validate latency and cost for a customer-facing autocomplete feature. Before we kick off procurement I need a few concrete items from Redwood so I can brief procurement and legal:

- A simple matrix of SLA tiers (uptime %), incident response targets (P1/P2/P3), and what escalation coverage looks like (on-call, follow-the-sun).
- How service credits are calculated for downtime.
- Packaging/pricing for pilot vs reserved capacity (example pricing for 1M tokens/month vs 10M).
- Discounting for committed spend / seat-based discounts for our platform team (we're evaluating a 12-month commit after pilot if it looks good).

To be transparent, procurement will want to see the maximum standard discount you provide without exec approval and an example discount for a 12-month $150k commit. Also please include any onboarding/rollback credits or onboarding SLA exceptions you can offer.

Could you get me a short proposal + a one-sheet table by early next week? Our target decision window is the week of Aug 3.

Appreciate it,
Maria

Maria Sanchez
VP, Platform Engineering | Acme Cloud Services
maria.sanchez@acme.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA and pricing for pilot + seat discounts
Attachments: SLA_Tiers_Table.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Maria —

Thanks — attached is a concise SLA + pricing one-sheet that should help procurement. High-level summary below, then a few clarifying questions so we can make the numbers concrete.

SLA tiers (summary):
- Standard: 99.5% uptime, P1 initial response 8 business hours, 24/5 on-call; credits = 5% monthly credit for downtime > threshold.
- Enhanced: 99.9% uptime, P1 initial response 4 hours, 24/7 on-call escalation to on-call engineer; credits = 10% monthly credit for qualifying incidents.
- Premium: 99.95% uptime, P1 initial response 1 hour, 24/7 priority escalation + named account escalation path; credits = 15% monthly credit and optional on-site tech review.

Pricing & discounting examples (pilot -> commit):
- Pilot (3 months): pay-as-you-go hosted API rates, no upfront commit; recommended to start on Enhanced for reliability.
- 12-month reserved: example pricing tiers attached for 1M / 5M / 10M tokens per month with reserved discounts.
- Volume discount guidance: standard discounts up to 15% for reserved commitments; for multi-year or large single-year commits we commonly extend 18–25% with sales leadership approval.

Onboarding / credits: we can offer one month of free pilot usage (capped) and a $10k onboarding credit applied after go-live for customers who commit to 12 months.

Questions for you:
- Expected monthly token volume (or QPS) during pilot and projected post-commit.
- Is Acme expecting a single-region deployment or multi-region? (affects pricing/latency)
- Any internal requirements for maximum allowable credit in contract language?

If you confirm volume and preferred tier I can put together a pricing sheet with a concrete discount proposal. Looping in Lauren for discount approval and legal/pricing guardrails.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0198

---
SLA_Tiers_Table.xlsx attached (includes per-tier SLA definitions, credit calculation examples, and sample pricing lines).

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flexible SLA package + seat discount proposal for Acme

Karthik — quick notes on approvals and what we can offer without further escalation: 

- Standard commercial cap: up to 18% discount on list pricing for 12-month reserved commitments can be approved by Sales Ops. Anything >18% requires VP approval.
- Bundled seat discounts (for platform engineers / seats managing the product) can be offered as an additional 5–7% off reserved pricing but should count toward overall discount cap.
- For P1 response: Enhanced (4h) is fine for pilot; for Premium (1h) we should reserve for deals with >$250k committed ARR or executive sign-off.
- Service credits: keep the standard mapping (attached) but avoid uncapped liability language — legal will push back.
- For Acme specifically: if they commit $150k for 12 months we can offer 20% total discount (18% standard + 2% promotional) and the $10k onboarding credit. Approve that as a negotiated starting point.

Say you propose: Enhanced SLA (99.9%), 24/7 P1 escalation, 4-hour initial response, 20% discount on reserved pricing for $150k commit, $10k onboarding credit, and DocuSign for signature. That should get procurement moving.

LMK once you send the revised proposal and I'll prioritize any exec sign-off if they push for more.

— Lauren
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Enhanced SLA + 12-month reserved pricing (proposal)
Attachments: Credit_Terms_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Maria / Procurement team —

Per our conversation and Lauren's guidance, attached is a short proposal and credit schedule reflecting the terms we discussed. Key items:

- Selected SLA: Enhanced (99.9% uptime) with 24/7 P1 escalation and 4-hour initial response for P1 incidents.
- Pricing: 12-month reserved commitment option example (based on your projected 10M tokens/month): 20% discount on reserved list pricing for a $150k committed spend.
- Onboarding credit: $10k one-time credit applied post-go-live.
- Service credits: as defined in the attached PDF (tiered monthly credits tied to minutes of downtime).
- Legal: standard limitation of liability applies; credit is the exclusive remedy for SLA breaches except for gross negligence.

If this matches Acme's needs, please follow this DocuSign link to review and sign by COB Aug 4 to lock the 20% promotional pricing: https://docusign.com/RW-ACME-2026-07-sign

If procurement needs an alternate payment schedule or a PO-first workflow, we can accommodate — let me know the PO terms and I'll loop in billing.

Thanks — excited to get you onboarded.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
